definitions.explanation: The act or time of being born.
The place where one was born or originated from.
Used to indicate the year of birth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{生|う}まれです。
{生|う}まれ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{育|そだ}ち→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧です。
examples.english: I was born and raised in Osaka.
He comes from a good family.

examples.japanese: {生|う}まれながら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{生|う}まれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{違|ちが}って→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Even if your backgrounds are different, you can become friends.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧{生|う}まれなので、⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}きだ→好き：02355_suki⟧。
examples.english: Since I was born in the countryside, I love nature.

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何年|なんねん}→何年：12737_nannen⟧{生|う}まれです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What year were you born in?

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧{生|う}まれ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I have many friends who were born in the same year.

notes:
{生|う}まれ is the noun form of ⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧ (to be born). It is commonly used to state one's birthplace or birth year in self-introductions.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{生|う}まれ: born in ~ (place or year)
- {生|う}まれ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧〜: born and raised in ~
- ⟦{生|う}まれつき→生まれつき：21201_umaretsuki⟧: by nature, innately, from birth
- {生|う}まれ⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: innate, born with
- ⟦{生|う}まれ{変|か}わる→生まれ変わる：13522_umarekawaru⟧: to be reborn

USAGE:
Often follows a place name or year directly: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{生|う}まれ (Tokyo-born), 1990⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧{生|う}まれ (born in 1990). The pattern {生|う}まれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ means 'from a good family' (refers to social background, not just birthplace).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧: one's origin/hometown (more formal, used on forms and resumes)
- {生|う}まれ: where/when one was born (more conversational)
